{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate: keep the row with the highest sample_seq for each patient
df_dedup = df.drop_duplicates(subset='patient_id', keep='last')

# Verify: ensure we have 800 unique patients
assert len(df_dedup) == 800, "Deduplication did not result in 800 unique patients"

# Correct assay_batch B values: divide by 10 to convert from µg/L to ng/mL
df_dedup.loc[df_dedup['assay_batch'] == 'B', 'biomarker_final'] /= 10

# Compute the mean biomarker_final in ng/mL
mean_biomarker_final = df_dedup['biomarker_final'].mean()

# Print result
print(f"Mean biomarker_final (ng/mL): {mean_biomarker_final}")"}
